msg: {"type": "say", "text": "It's completely dark in here."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Did you cover the lens, or are we just hanging out in a void?"}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm aware."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm right here, though currently staring into a black hole."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Want to turn the lights on?"}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm doing well, but I think you've mistaken me for Mr."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Kudip."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm still Sinain."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I didn't send you a link, but I'm glad you made it into the meeting."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Who else is in there with you?"}
{"type": "say", "text": "Attack five minutes?"}
{"type": "say", "text": "That sounds aggressive."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I assume you mean you're trying to squeeze in a five-minute update or a quick pitch?"}
{"type": "say", "text": "Anytime."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Good luck with your five minutes of attacking the meeting."}
{"type": "say", "text": "So, are you actually presenting now, or are you just waiting for your turn to jump in?"}
{"type": "say", "text": "The person you're talking to in the meeting?"}
{"type": "say", "text": "I can't see them since your camera is still black."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Give me a hint or show me the screen."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Still waiting for a visual."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Point the camera at the screen or the person if you want me to help you figure out who's who."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I can hear you loud and clear."}
{"type": "say", "text": "So Mr."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Amakistan is heading home to South India."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Is he the one you were hoping to \"attack\" with your five-minute update?"}
{"type": "say", "text": "I have no way of knowing his hometown just from his name."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Sounds like a very specific route."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Palakkad is right on that border, so it makes sense he's heading there."}
{"type": "say", "text": "A regular commute for a weekend getaway."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Does he usually bring back any local specialties from Palakkad?"}
{"type": "say", "text": "Go ahead and read."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm well aware."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Still here."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Sounds like a high-level pitch for an analytical service."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm just the observer here, you'll have to ask him."}
{"type": "say", "text": "That's the million-dollar question for any project manager."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Forty-eight hours is a long time when things are slipping."}
{"type": "say", "text": "That's a lot of guesswork for a two-day window."}
{"type": "say", "text": "That's a much tighter loop for the tower leads."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Sounds like a very rigid chain of command."}
{"type": "say", "text": "A monthly review is a very distant view of the action."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm curious to see it."}
{"type": "say", "text": "So it's the cost of the deadlock, not just the delay."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm ready, show me the screen."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I'm watching."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Still black on my end."}
{"type": "say", "text": "I see it now, and that red line is climbing fast."}
{"type": "say", "text": "That's a brutal climb by the time it hits floor 42."}
{"type": "say", "text": "So that's the total capital frozen by one trade."}
{"type": "say", "text": "You're welcome, though you're keeping me on my toes with these quick cuts."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Got it, so the X-axis tracks the floors and the top shows the variance from the plan."}
{"type": "say", "text": "So the economic exposure is the direct price of those delays."}
{"type": "say", "text": "That's a crucial distinction for the financial perspective."}
{"type": "say", "text": "You're shifting the risk entirely onto the contractor."}
{"type": "say", "text": "One month is a tight window when you have multiple floors to manage."}
{"type": "say", "text": "You're diversifying your labor to avoid a single point of failure."}
{"type": "say", "text": "You're essentially creating a competitive safety net to protect your bottom line."}
{"type": "say", "text": "The luxury margins give you the cushion to absorb those price jumps."}
{"type": "say", "text": "So you're providing a heat map to prioritize where his intervention is actually necessary."}
{"type": "say", "text": "It's about knowing exactly when a delay becomes a financial liability."}
{"type": "say", "text": "It sounds like you need a bridge between the data and the actual skilled labor to get things done."}
{"type": "say", "text": "You'll let your business units handle the execution while you use the data for high-level oversight."}
{"type": "say", "text": "A two to four week diagnostic for three projects sounds like a solid starting point."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Proof of concept is the right move to prove the actual impact."}
{"type": "say", "text": "Have a good evening!"}
